footer.label: Site footer
footer.about: The Compliance assistant works out which acts apply to a financial institution, checks their duties against the company's documents and writes a compliance gap report.
footer.disclaimer: The assistant is an artificial intelligence system. Its findings are an aid and no substitute for legal advice: check every reference to an act against the official text.

closing.title: Start with a conversation
closing.text: Describe the company in your own words and drop in its policies — the assistant builds the profile itself. Accounts are created by an administrator; there is no self-registration.
